full_page.content:
Page 94 Cont.
Dec. 6 Gustav Steel - 50 - nervecus - cannot sleep.
Mrs. Jean Bourdeau - 34 - Windsor - adhesions fears operation
Eleanor DeGuvera - 47 - of Romeo - tripple break of leg year ago bro- ken over agan and still fears further breaking ...
8 Thanks - Celia Ososki - 4 - Mastoid operat. averted - nothing wrong when taken back to Ann Arbor.
Agnes Baron - 48 - Enemic seemingly hopeless ....
10 Theresa Manion - 12 - ear trouble seemingly effecting whole system Ignatius Zielinski - 45 - tuomer on sholder - broke last two mo's ago. It is feared he is getting weaker
John Merlo - 80 - dropsey - heart -- for grace of resignation & Happy death.
Page 95
Dec. 12th Mrs. Laura Otto - 45 - Providence Hosp. - throat-cancer Case seems very threatening. She has four children and Husband .... asking for prayers.
Dolores Malothe - 23 - wayward - refuses to come home instead of living with bad company. deaf to parents pleas to pray. Enrolled To-day - Father turning to drink.
C. Detchocht about 60 - nerveous cannot sleep ...... went to confession This a.m. first time since 1910. Will sleep To-night O.V.
Mrs. Cath. Burns - 70 - fell about two yrs. ago .... has never fully re- covered - concussion of brain feared
Thanksgiving - family quarrel smoothed off .... Peace restored. Divorce abandoned.
Mrs. Fred Cousino - 50 - threaten - 3rd opera.
Mrs. A. Waryas 50 - stroke - able to work but 12 yrs speechless
Mary Boyle - 11 - Infantile Paral. one year ... cannot go to school. Leon Langvill- 51 - Stroke a yr. ago - in Aloyse
